Score method & file scores
Score uses verified completed checks only. Passed ÷ completed checks × 100, less confirmed finding penalties (high 12, medium 5, low 2 per occurrence). Unverified and unavailable checks are not passes. File scores start at 100 with confirmed severity deductions (high 30, medium 15, low 7 per occurrence). A score is not a guarantee of quality.

Proposed file replacement

 

 







  
GitHub Publish

  

    
Connect GitHub in Settings to select your repository.

    
    

    
All files unpacked; one commit

    
Load an HTML file, ZIP or complete website project before publishing.

    
Publishes unzipped files to main in one commit without deleting unrelated files. React source preview is best-effort only; use the real production build output for deployment. A source ZIP is not a runnable Pages build. Private .env/key files and common credentials are blocked before upload. No upload starts until Publish.

    
    

    

  



  
Create repository

  

    
Create a public repository under the connected personal account. Organization repositories depend on your GitHub permissions.
